bio: Agostina Iannaccaro, whose name is also recorded as Guistina, was born about 1616 at San Mango di Aquino in Catanzaro, Calabria. She died there on 25 April 1685, the date of her entry in the San Mango parish burial register. She is John's 11th-great-grandmother.
